item: custom model rows carry the selection checkmark (2026-08-25)
branch: renderModels() emits .pi-check on EVERY row; custom rows get the remove (×) IN ADDITION, plus a .custom class; #modelMenu .popup-item.custom:hover .pi-check hides the ✓ so the hover-revealed × replaces it; the × button lives INSIDE .pi-check, overlaying the ✓'s box, so the two glyph centers coincide by construction
provenance: Both injected frames are OUR OWN Kotlin->webview frames (self-consistency only, by design): the __models roster items are copied from fixture 55's step 1, which recorded them VERBATIM from the CLI's initialize/list_models response (CLI 2.1.241, 2026-08-24); the __customModels item mirrors what ChatPanel.kt pushes back — the JSON that persistCustom() itself serialized, so entries carry custom:true (parseCustomModel's shape). Selection is injected via the __models frame's `selected` (the ChatPanel restore path, 70-events.js), NOT via setModel — nothing is persisted and no set_model reaches the live CLI; the restore step re-injects the saved roster/custom list the same way. Menu opened by CLICKING THE CHIP, never by adding .show (tg() positioning gotcha). The hover swap (✓ -> ×) is NOT asserted here — CDP cannot synthesize a real :hover — it was verified in real JCEF 2026-08-25 via CDP CSS.forcePseudoState — re-run after the × moved INSIDE the check span — on BOTH custom-row states (selected: rest ✓ visible/× none, hover ✓ svg hidden/× shown; unselected: rest nothing, hover × shown via its explicit visibility:visible inside the hidden span), with glyph-center dx=dy=0 under hover both times. A one-time probe, not a harness assert, because Panel.eval speaks Runtime.evaluate only. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-25 against the pre-fix webview (whole plugin/src/main/resources/webview/ dir restored to HEAD via git stash, sandbox restarted, build verified BY CONTENT): the GUARDs (display, onRowV, otherCheckVisible, delExists) passed — the .on class was always computed correctly for custom rows — and the two DISCRIMINATING asserts failed exactly as the bug predicts (7 passed, 2 failed): onRowCustom false != true (no custom class emitted), checkVisible null != 'visible' (the ternary emitted the × INSTEAD of the ✓ — no .pi-check node on the custom row at all), which is the reported symptom: a selected custom row with no tick.

expect.why: GUARD: the popup is really laid out — everything below is void otherwise
GUARD: the .on class lands on the custom row — true even pre-fix (the comparison at 30-menus.js was never the bug), so this only anchors WHICH row the discriminating asserts read
DISCRIMINATING: the row carries the .custom class the hover-swap CSS keys on (pre-fix: no such class existed)
DISCRIMINATING: the custom row HAS a .pi-check and .popup-item.on reveals it (pre-fix: null — the ternary emitted the × instead, no check node at all — the reported bug)
GUARD: a non-selected built-in row's check stays hidden — the unconditional span did not light every row
GUARD: the remove (×) button still exists on the custom row — the check is ADDED, not swapped in

DISCRIMINATING: the × glyph's horizontal center sits exactly on the ✓'s — the hover swap must not jump. Pre-align control (sibling button, right:8px): FAILED with 2 != 0 — note the naive stylesheet math predicted 5, but the #inputbar 18px svg ID rule resizes both glyphs (the documented trap), which is WHY the fix overlays instead of computing offsets
DISCRIMINATING: vertical centers match — the × overlays the check span (inset 1px 0 0 0, matching its padding-top), not the row middle, so rows with a description stay aligned too

DISCRIMINATING: the × svg RENDERS at the ✓'s size — center alignment alone cannot catch a symmetric shrink. Pre-fix control: FAILED with -8 (the `#inputbar button {padding:4px}` ID rule beat .model-del's padding:0 inside the 18px overlay, flex-squeezing the × svg to 10px while the ✓ stayed 18 — the user saw a tiny ×)
